issue.title: xunit.runner.visualstudio pkg produces errors in cloud build/test

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

repository.name: xunit
repository.description: xUnit.net is a free, open source, community-focused unit testing tool for .NET.

issue.body:
When installing the `xunit.runner.visualstudio` package to my xunit test project, I'm pleased to see that it makes cloud build in visualstudio.com automatically support running xunit tests. Way cool.

However, before the tests run, I see a nasty looking error message that causes cloud build to report only 'partial succeeded' instead of a succeeded build. The build output is below.

The fix is that the `xunit.runner.visualstudio.testadapter.dll` file should _not_ be included in the build output of the test project. It's referenced by the test project by the NuGet package although there is no reason to be referenced. If I set the reference to CopyLocal=false it fixes the error in the cloud build. Since the reference isn't necessary at all (even at compile time), it seems this `xunit.runner.visualstudio.testadapter.dll` file only needs to be found in the project directory of the build server -- something NuGet Restore can already do. I believe then that this file should belong to the `build\` folder of the nuget package rather than the `lib\` folder, so that it will be present, but not have a reference added to that file to the project that the package is installed into. In this way, I believe the package will still work its magic, but without the error below.
